how_to_read: REPLAY LANE, the same shape tests/golden/l2 uses. `model_answer` is what R-2 returned when this fixture was labelled, and on more than half of them it is WRONG ON PURPOSE — what this set grades is OUR CODE: the gauntlet, the number substitution, the fallback. `situation` is expanded into a real ReasoningDecision with real units, candidates, constraints and citations by tests/reason/test_bundle_gauntlet.py, so nothing here is a mock of the contract. `expect.gauntlet` is pass/fail/not_run; `expect.checks_failed` names WHICH check must catch it, so a fixture that starts failing for a different reason is a regression rather than a pass. `model_answer: null` means no generation existed at all — the budget was spent, the tenant was not activated, or the model did not return JSON. THE TEN-SECOND TEST IS A HUMAN STANDARD and it is why `expect.rendered` is committed: a reviewer reads the card exactly as a founder would, with every number already substituted.
